text:
elliot: @maya quick ping — sketching a proposal for automatic model-variant fallback when the primary is saturated. need per-tenant console toggle, an API hint/header, and clear telemetry. sketch below, thoughts?

maya: short +1. are we doing region-aware preferences too or just tenant-level?

elliot: priority order i'm thinking: tenant override -> region preference -> global default. console should show status + allow dry-run. API header for callers that can tolerate lower-quality quantized variants.

sam: avoid oscillation. we need rate-limited failover with cooldown and sample logging for quality checks. also sticky routing per chat session.

frank: API header proposal: one enum header rather than many booleans. e.g.

```
X-Redwood-Variant-Preference: prefer_compatible
```

and optional region hint: `X-Redwood-Variant-Region: eu-west-1`

maya: i prefer a single header with small enum values rather than proliferating headers. we should also surface an explicit dry-run header so partners can opt-in to telemetry-only.

elliot: example set I'm putting in the RFC: 
```
X-Redwood-Variant-Preference: prefer_compatible
X-Redwood-Variant-Region: eu-west-1
X-Redwood-Variant-Mode: dry-run
```

sam: i'd rather the mode be a separate header, otherwise parsing gets weird for proxies. suggestions: `X-Redwood-Variant-Mode: dry-run|enforced`

maya: console UX ideas: per-tenant toggle, a percent rollout slider, and a dry-run checkbox that still emits `decision_reason` telemetry but doesn't actually reroute. show a 24/72h comparison chart for latency, token cost, and quality regression.

ops-bot: config update: feature-flag `variant_fallback_v1` will gate rollout.

frank: infra notes: we'll need metrics: `fallback_rate` (per-tenant, per-region), `fallback_latency_delta_ms`, `fallback_cost_delta_tokens`, and `fallback_quality_regressions` (from eval harness). also expose `fallback_decision_count` taggable by reason (capacity, quota, manual).

elliot: rollout plan in RFC: 1) dry-run 1% tenants for 24h, log telemetry; 2) 10% for 72h with automated quality checks against tenant prompt-set; 3) increment to 50% with gradual rollbacks on regression >2%. add sticky_variant_ttl to avoid mid-conversation swaps.

sam: sticky_variant_ttl is crucial. if we switch variant mid-session we break KV cache. propose default = 30m, tenant override allowed.

maya: who owns console UI and visibility? i'll take UI mockups. i'll need API contract and telemetry field list: `decision_reason`, `original_model`, `selected_variant`, `queue_delay_ms`, `route_attempts`, `is_dry_run`.

frank: infra will own metrics and router flags. prefer we implement header parsing in the edge proxy layer to avoid touching every service.

elliot: created RFC PR (https://redwood.internal/rfcs/312) with header proposal, telemetry spec, and rollout plan. pls review. i'll add the sticky_ttl and explicit cooldown/circuit-breaker behavior.

maya: :thumbsup: i'll review the mock and leave comments on the RFC by EOD.

sam: +1. one last thought — add a small sample rate of full-output logging (not just metrics) for a subset of fallbacks so evaluation team can assess qualitative quality.

elliot: good call. will include `sample_fallback_trace_rate` in telemetry config. thanks all.
